text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a significant medical history and are presenting with gait and limb ataxia; to understand the underlying cause, can you describe exactly when these symptoms first started and if they have worsened over time?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for describing those symptoms. Since you mentioned the clumsiness is particularly noticeable on your right side, can you tell me if you have noticed any specific difficulties with your hands, such as buttoning a shirt or writing, or if you have experienced any numbness or tingling?

text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.
